title: GridForge: An Open Physics-Informed Digital Twin and Benchmark Suite for UK 11 kV Underground Distribution Cables
abstract: arXiv:2611.23241v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The UK distribution-cable monitoring sector is data-rich but framework-poor: each Distribution Network Operator (DNO) collects megabytes of telemetry per asset per day, but there is no public benchmark dataset, no shared reference model, and no commonly agreed evaluation protocol for benchmarking sectoral, data-intensive models for operational decision support; notably for maintenance planning and prioritisation. We address this gap with GridForge, an open-source physics-informed digital twin and benchmark suite for fault diagnosis and prediction, integrating four building blocks: (i) a verified steady state and transient thermal model based on IEC 60287 and IEC 60853; (ii) a calibrated synthetic dataset of 64 cables (covering 320 cable-years) representing four canonical UK 11 kV thermal archetypes and four condition modes; (iii) a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) surrogate that satisfies the algebraic balance defined by IEC 60287

translated_title: GridForge：面向英国11千伏地下配电电缆的开放物理信息数字孪生与基准测试套件
translated_abstract: 英国配电电缆监测领域呈现出数据丰富但框架匮乏的状态：各配电网络运营商（DNO）每天针对每个资产收集数兆字节的遥测数据，然而在对用于运营决策支持（尤其是维护规划与优先级排序）的行业数据密集型模型进行基准评估时，既没有公开的基准数据集，也没有共享的参考模型，更缺乏公认的评估协议。我们通过GridForge来填补这一空白——这是一个用于故障诊断与预测的开源物理信息数字孪生与基准测试套件，集成了四个组成部分：(i) 基于IEC 60287和IEC 60853标准并经过验证的稳态与暂态热模型；(ii) 一个经过校准的合成数据集，包含64条电缆（覆盖320电缆年），代表四种典型的英国11千伏热学类型和四种状态模式；(iii) 一个满足IEC 60287所定义代数平衡关系的物理信息神经网络（PINN）代理模型
tldr: 本文提出了GridForge——一个开源的物理信息数字孪生与基准测试套件，为英国11千伏地下配电电缆领域提供了首个公开基准数据集、经验证的IEC标准热模型以及物理信息神经网络（PINN）代理模型，填补了该领域在故障诊断与预测模型评估协议上的空白。
en_tdlr: GridForge provides an open-source physics-informed digital twin and benchmark suite for UK 11 kV underground distribution cables, delivering the sector's first public benchmark dataset, verified IEC-standard thermal models, and a PINN surrogate for fault diagnosis and prediction.
